verdict.rationale: Data-retention controls are a fair privacy question for a package manager, so the axis applies. However, the pack documents no privacy-oriented retention or deletion controls for user data, such as telemetry or analytics retention, data-deletion requests, or retention policies. The Nix store garbage collector and community-mentioned auto-gc only reclaim disk space from unused packages. That is an adjacent package-cleanup feature, not control over user-data retention, so it earns no credit.
